# Circuit: 4x1 RAM: four 1-bit words, address A1 A0, write W, data D, output OUT. Contract:
# doc/redstone/circuits.md, "4x1 RAM". Generated by tools/circuitgen/ram4.py.
#
# Module (box 0 1 -6 .. 15 3 36):
#   @A1 0 1 -6, @A0 4 1 -6, @W 8 1 -6, @D 10 1 -6   input wires: drive them from the north
#   @OUT 15 3 35   repeater facing south: the addressed word
# How it works: the inputs become six literal columns on the floor (A1, not A1, A0, not A0,
#   not W, D; each 2 ticks late, by a repeater or a torch). Each column passes 12 crossings
#   (a repeater, a stone, then under a top-layer line); a wire on a crossing's stone steps
#   up into that line: a diode tap. Per word m: LOCK = not W or A != m holds its latch (a
#   repeater locked from the side, d_latch), D feeds it, and READ = A != m blocks its read
#   comparator (latch - 15 READ), which points into the OUT bus.
# Timing: OUT shows a word 32 ticks after the address changes (every word's read path is
#   balanced to 32, so switching between two 1s never dips). A write needs W on for 2+
#   ticks; D is sampled 2 ticks after W falls; the address must not change while W is on
#   (up to 1 tick before W falls is still safe). A written word is stored 14-32 ticks after W.
# Test harness outside the box: levers @LA1 @LA0 @LW @LD north of the inputs.
#   redsim-cli ram4.redsim.json < examples/circuits/ram4.cli.txt
new size 96 force
note "4x1 RAM: W writes D into word A1 A0; @OUT shows the addressed word 32 ticks after the address changes"
line 0 1 -6 to 0 1 -3 redstone_wire
place 1 1 -3 redstone_wire
set 2 1 -3 stone
place 2 1 -2 redstone_wall_torch facing=south
place 0 1 -2 repeater out=south
place 0 1 -1 redstone_wire
place 2 1 -1 redstone_wire
line 4 1 -6 to 4 1 -3 redstone_wire
place 5 1 -3 redstone_wire
set 6 1 -3 stone
place 6 1 -2 redstone_wall_torch facing=south
place 4 1 -2 repeater out=south
place 4 1 -1 redstone_wire
place 6 1 -1 redstone_wire
line 8 1 -6 to 8 1 -4 redstone_wire
set 8 1 -3 stone
place 8 1 -2 redstone_wall_torch facing=south
place 8 1 -1 redstone_wire
line 10 1 -6 to 10 1 -3 redstone_wire
place 10 1 -2 repeater out=south
place 10 1 -1 redstone_wire

label A1 0 1 -6 "address bit 1: wire, driven from the north"
label A0 4 1 -6 "address bit 0: wire, driven from the north"
label W 8 1 -6 "write: wire, driven from the north"
label D 10 1 -6 "data: wire, driven from the north"
label OUT 15 3 35 "output: the addressed word (repeater facing south)"
settle
group ram4 0 1 -6 15 3 36 in @A1 A1 in @A0 A0 in @W W in @D D out @OUT OUT
prefab save ram4 0 1 -6 15 3 36
# harness
place 0 1 -7 lever face=floor
place 4 1 -7 lever face=floor
place 8 1 -7 lever face=floor
place 10 1 -7 lever face=floor
label LA1 0 1 -7 "test lever A1"
label LA0 4 1 -7 "test lever A0"
label LW 8 1 -7 "test lever W"
label LD 10 1 -7 "test lever D"
settle

target new store "write 1, 0, 1, 1 into words 0..3 (W 20 ticks each), then read 0, 1, 2, 3 every 60 ticks from 200: OUT 1, 0, 1, 1, 32 ticks after each address"
target store do at 10 use @LD
target store do at 15 use @LW
target store do at 35 use @LW
target store do at 50 use @LA0
target store do at 50 use @LD
target store do at 55 use @LW
target store do at 75 use @LW
target store do at 90 use @LA0
target store do at 90 use @LA1
target store do at 90 use @LD
target store do at 95 use @LW
target store do at 115 use @LW
target store do at 130 use @LA0
target store do at 135 use @LW
target store do at 155 use @LW
target store do at 200 use @LA0
target store do at 200 use @LA1
target store do at 260 use @LA0
target store do at 320 use @LA0
target store do at 320 use @LA1
target store do at 380 use @LA0
target store expect @Q0 powered=true during 200..440
target store expect @Q1 powered=false during 0..440
target store expect @Q2 powered=true during 200..440
target store expect @Q3 powered=true during 200..440
target store expect @OUT powered=true during 180..291
target store expect @OUT powered=false during 292..351
target store expect @OUT powered=true during 352..440

target new switch "words 0 and 3 hold 1, word 1 holds 0: address 0 -> 3 -> 0 keeps OUT on (no dip), -> 1 turns it off 32 ticks later"
target switch do use @LD
target switch do at 10 use @LW
target switch do at 30 use @LW
target switch do at 40 use @LA0
target switch do at 40 use @LA1
target switch do at 50 use @LW
target switch do at 70 use @LW
target switch do at 120 use @LA0
target switch do at 120 use @LA1
target switch do at 180 use @LA0
target switch do at 180 use @LA1
target switch do at 240 use @LA1
target switch expect @OUT powered=true during 110..271
target switch expect @OUT powered=false during 272..300

target new sample "D is sampled 2 ticks after W falls: word 0, W 10..29 with D on; D off at 32 is stored (0), D off at 33 in word 1 is not (1)"
target sample do use @LD
target sample do at 10 use @LW
target sample do at 30 use @LW
target sample do at 32 use @LD
target sample do at 40 use @LA0
target sample do at 40 use @LD
target sample do at 50 use @LW
target sample do at 70 use @LW
target sample do at 73 use @LD
target sample expect @Q0 powered=false during 60..140
target sample expect @Q1 powered=true during 110..140

target new address_late "failure case: the address changes while W is on. 1 tick before W falls is still safe (only word 0 is written); 2 ticks before, word 1 is written too"
target address_late do use @LD
target address_late do at 10 use @LW
target address_late do at 30 use @LW
target address_late do at 29 use @LA0
target address_late do at 60 use @LA0
target address_late do at 60 use @LA1
target address_late do at 70 use @LW
target address_late do at 90 use @LW
target address_late do at 88 use @LA0
target address_late expect @Q0 powered=true during 50..150
target address_late expect @Q1 powered=false during 0..150
target address_late expect @Q2 powered=true during 120..150
target address_late expect @Q3 powered=true during 130..150

target new short "a 1-tick W writes nothing (the not-W torch ignores it); 2 ticks write"
target short do use @LD
target short do at 10 use @LW
target short do at 11 use @LW
target short do at 40 use @LA0
target short do at 50 use @LW
target short do at 52 use @LW
target short expect @Q0 powered=false during 0..120
target short expect @Q1 powered=true during 90..120

target new overwrite "word 0 <- 1 (W 10..29), word 2 <- 1 (W 50..69), word 2 <- 0 (W 90..109): word 2 is 1 from 76 to 115, then 0; word 0 keeps its 1"
target overwrite do use @LD
target overwrite do at 10 use @LW
target overwrite do at 30 use @LW
target overwrite do at 40 use @LA1
target overwrite do at 50 use @LW
target overwrite do at 70 use @LW
target overwrite do at 80 use @LD
target overwrite do at 90 use @LW
target overwrite do at 110 use @LW
target overwrite expect @Q0 powered=true during 30..160
target overwrite expect @Q2 powered=true during 76..115
target overwrite expect @Q2 powered=false during 116..160

check
